name: tilth-website
description: Tilth marketing website — static site with a dependency-free Node generator (src/ -> static HTML for GitHub Pages).

scripts.check:domain:
node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{const files=require('node:child_process').execSync('git ls-files "*.html"').toString().split('
').filter(Boolean);let bad=[];for(const f of files){if(f==='index.original.html')continue;const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(/https://tilth\.in/.test(s))bad.push(f);}console.log(bad.length?('legacy domain refs in:
'+bad.join('
')):'no https://tilth.in refs');})"
